extDescr.message: Session manager and tab saver. With sync.

p_overwriteGroup_popup.message: A group with this name already exists. Replace its tabs with the current tabs?

p_addLinkToGroup_btn_title.message: Add a link to the group

p_syncStorageDefault_error.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

o_tabs_help.description: Tab name. Prefix 'o_' for options page

o_savedTabs_legend.message: Tabs to save in groups (sessions are not affected)

o_help_syncStorage.message: Tab groups are stored in browser sync storage. Sign in to the browser to get them on your other computers.

o_help_syncStorage_1.message: Sync storage is limited in size. You can see how much of it is used (No. 1 on the screenshot).

o_help_syncStorage_2.message: Groups are compressed, so a group can have hundreds of tabs. Every group is also kept on this computer: if sync storage is full, the group is still saved and marked with ⚠ until there is room in sync.

o_help_quickAdd.message: To quickly save all open tabs as a group, just open the extension window and press Enter.

o_help_showLinks.message: To see the tabs of a saved group, click the gray triangle (No. 2 on the screenshot).

o_help_inNewWindow.message: Ctrl + click on a group (or session) name opens it in a new window. You can also click the icon next to the group name (No. 3 on the screenshot).

o_help_editGroup.message: You can edit, delete and move any saved group (No. 4 on the screenshot).

o_help_overFavicon.message: Hover over a tab's icon to see its URL.

o_help_settings.message: Take a look at the extension's settings.

o_sessionWatcher_toggle.message: Watch sessions. Uncheck to turn off automatic session saving. The extension will reload automatically.

o_backup_backupInstruction.message: Press "Download backup file" to save your groups and settings to a file. You can also copy the text below.

o_backup_backupInstructionMore.message: You can use it to restore your saved groups and settings. Sessions are not included.

o_backup_restoreInstruction.message: Choose a backup file or paste backup text below, then press "Restore settings and saved groups".

o_backup_restoreInstructionMore.message: Saved groups are replaced by the ones from the backup. Groups that are not in the backup go to "Recently deleted" (below on this page), and you can undo the restore.

bg_conflictCopy.description: Added to the name of a group copy kept when the group was edited on two computers at once

p_notSynced_title.message: Saved on this computer only, not in browser sync
p_notSynced_title.description: Tooltip of the mark next to a saved group that is not in browser sync

p_notSyncedCount.description: After the sync storage usage on the Saved groups tab

p_savedLocally_full.message: Saved on this computer only: browser sync storage is full. Delete groups you no longer need to sync it.
p_savedLocally_full.description: Shown when a group was saved but sync storage has no room

p_savedLocally_later.message: Saved on this computer. It will be synced later.
p_savedLocally_later.description: Shown when a group was saved but could not reach sync storage right now

p_nothingToSave.message: No tabs to save. Pinned tabs are skipped unless you turn them on in Settings.
p_nothingToSave.description: Shown when Save finds no tabs to save

p_groupDeleted_text.description: Bar shown for a few seconds after a group is deleted

p_undo_btn.description: Button on the bar after a group is deleted

o_backup_error_notBackup.message: This is not a TabHamster backup. Nothing was changed.

o_backup_error_damaged.message: Some groups in this backup can't be read. Nothing was changed.

o_backup_error_empty.message: No saved groups or settings found in this backup. Nothing was changed.

o_trash_info.message: Deleted groups are kept here for 30 days, including groups deleted on your other computers.

o_help_recentlyDeleted.message: Deleted groups can be restored for 30 days: Settings > Backup / Restore > Recently deleted.
o_help_recentlyDeleted.description: Help tab tip: where deleted groups can be restored

p_field_placeholder.description: Popup field: it searches saved groups, and its text is the name of a new group

p_field_label.message: Search groups, or name a new one
p_field_label.description: Screen reader label of the popup field

p_saveTabs_other.description: Save button (plural form 'other'). Translations may add _few, _many forms

p_tabsCount_one.description: Number of tabs in a group (plural form 'one')

p_tabsCount_other.description: Number of tabs in a group (plural form 'other')

p_windowsCount_one.description: Number of windows in a session (plural form 'one')

p_windowsCount_other.description: Number of windows in a session (plural form 'other')

p_syncStorage.description: Popup footer, before the usage meter

p_syncStorageUsed.description: Screen reader label of the usage meter

p_open.description: Button on a group row: open its tabs in this window

p_openNewWindow.description: Icon button on a group row

p_moreActions.description: Icon button on a group row that opens its menu

p_expandGroup.description: Chevron button on a group row (screen reader label)

p_collapseGroup.description: Chevron button on an open group row (screen reader label)

p_currentSessionSince.description: Sessions tab: the session of the running browser

p_sessionsFooter.message: Last 30 sessions, kept on this computer only
p_sessionsFooter.description: Popup footer on the Sessions tab

p_loadError.message: Saved groups could not be loaded. Close and open TabHamster again.
p_loadError.description: Popup, when the background part doesn't answer

p_pinned.description: Screen reader label of the pin icon on a tab

p_saveAs.description: Save button while a new group name is typed

p_replaceGroup.description: Save button when the typed name is the name of a saved group: its tabs will be replaced by the open tabs

p_replaced_one.description: Bar after replacing a group's tabs (plural form 'one')

p_replaced_other.description: Bar after replacing a group's tabs (plural form 'other')

p_notSyncedYet.message: Saved on this computer only for now: Chrome sync storage is full.
p_notSyncedYet.description: Second line of the bar when a saved group didn't fit in sync storage

p_field_placeholder_first.description: Popup field before any group is saved (the name is optional)

p_empty_text.message: Press $KEY$ to keep the open tabs as a group. Type a name first, or leave it empty and the group is named by date and time.
p_empty_text.description: Popup, no saved groups yet. KEY is Enter or Return

p_empty_sync.message: With Chrome sync on, your groups also appear on your other computers.

p_empty_restore.description: Link in the popup when there are no saved groups: opens the backup page of the settings

p_clearSearch.description: Screen reader label of the button that clears the popup field

p_tabsMatching_one.description: Searching: a group found through its tabs, how many of its tabs match (plural form 'one', by the group's tab count)

p_tabsMatching_other.description: Searching: a group found through its tabs, how many of its tabs match (plural form 'other', by the group's tab count)

p_noGroupsMatch.description: Popup search found no saved groups

p_noMatch_text_one.message: Press $KEY$ to save the $COUNT$ open tab as a new group with this name.
p_noMatch_text_one.description: Under 'No groups match'. KEY is Enter or Return (plural form 'one', by the number of open tabs)

p_noMatch_text_other.message: Press $KEY$ to save the $COUNT$ open tabs as a new group with this name.
p_noMatch_text_other.description: Under 'No groups match'. KEY is Enter or Return (plural form 'other', by the number of open tabs)

p_replaceNote_one.description: Note above the list when the typed name is the name of a saved group (plural form 'one', by the group's tab count)

p_replaceNote_other.description: Note above the list when the typed name is the name of a saved group (plural form 'other', by the group's tab count)

p_replaceNote_text_one.message: $KEY$ replaces its tabs with the $COUNT$ open tab. You can undo it after saving.
p_replaceNote_text_one.description: Second line of the note. KEY is Enter or Return (plural form 'one', by the number of open tabs)

p_replaceNote_text_other.message: $KEY$ replaces its tabs with the $COUNT$ open tabs. You can undo it after saving.
p_replaceNote_text_other.description: Second line of the note. KEY is Enter or Return (plural form 'other', by the number of open tabs)

p_sameNameGroups_other.message: $COUNT$ groups have this name: the one saved last is replaced.
p_sameNameGroups_other.description: Added to the note when older groups already share the typed name (always 2 or more; plural form 'other', add _few, _many if needed)

p_replaceWithOpen.description: Group menu: the group's tabs become the tabs that Save would take

p_openTabsCount_one.description: Under 'Replace with open tabs' when Save takes the tabs of all windows (plural form 'one')

p_openTabsCount_other.description: Under 'Replace with open tabs' when Save takes the tabs of all windows (plural form 'other')

p_addCurrentTab.description: Group menu: adds the tab you are looking at to the group (its title is shown under it)

p_copyLinks.description: Group menu: copies the addresses of the group's tabs, one per line

p_groupName_label.description: Screen reader label of the field for renaming a group

p_saveName.description: Button next to the rename field

p_cancelRename.description: Button next to the rename field

p_nameTaken.description: Under the rename field when the typed name belongs to another group

p_deleted.description: Bar after deleting a group, with Undo

p_tabAdded.description: Bar after 'Add current tab', with Undo

p_alreadyInGroup.description: Bar when 'Add current tab' finds the tab's address in the group already

p_copyFailed.description: Bar when copying to the clipboard failed

p_openFailed.description: Bar when Chrome refused to open a window (for example incognito is turned off by an administrator). ERROR is Chrome's message, in English
